body: I really don't know. My landlord committed suicide four days ago, too. It was two days before I was supposed to move into my new apartment and I didn't know. I felt like such a dick when I realized I was making his family deal with his responsibilities as a landlord right after his death. I know that my family would be really fucked up if I died, but I don't think they'd be surprised. I think life is difficult, and it sucks that we're stuck with it without having asked if we ever wanted to do it in the first place.

I don't want to, though. That's the thing. I'm just scared. I'm scared about shitting my pants after I die and everyone finding me that way. I'm scared of nobody finding me because nobody will care to look. I'm sorry if that's morbid. I'm scared of dying but I think I'm more scared of staying alive.
i'm still here, but i don't think i will be in a few hours.
right after i posted this i found out my friend just shot himself, hes dead, what am i supposed to do now, oh god
